messages:
mina: Quick architect check-in: were seeing quality divergence on long-context when FP8/INT8/4bit slices get packed across the same cache region. Thinking about a "cache-fidelity partitioning" approach vs soft headers + scheduler hysteresis. Short thread to pick a low-risk rollout path.
oscar: Can you quantify the divergence? degscore / user-facing regressions?
mina: degscore on our longctx suite goes from ~0.04 to 0.11 in mixed-pack cases. Users report fuzzy tails. Logs show kv_hit drops and more compactions during those windows.
leah: Paste a sample schedule and kv page stats?
mina: ```
SCHED id=0x3fa bits=[fp8,4bit,fp8] seq_len=2100 kv_hit=0.57 page_compacts=3 tail_deg=0.12
SCHED id=0x3fb bits=[fp8,fp8,fp8] seq_len=400 kv_hit=0.95 page_compacts=0 tail_deg=0.01
```
samir: Two families of fixes: (1) prevent mixed quant co-residency (hard partition / fidelity namespaces) or (2) make co-residency safe (tiny KV header + per-entry format guards + smarter compaction). Tradeoffs: (1) memory blowup, simpler reasoning. (2) lower mem but more runtime complexity and telemetry requirements.
mina: I prefer progressive approach: header+hysteresis first (low blast radius), then soft fidelity partitions if header+hysteresis doesn't resolve. Also want replayability glue for debugging.
oscar: Agree. Header format suggestion: 1 byte magic + 1 byte ver + 1 byte quant_id + 2 byte len = 5 bytes. Adds ~0.5% token-cost in worst-case mem.
leah: Hysteresis scheduler: if tenant rolling tail_deg > 0.05 over 3m, prefer same-bit scheduling for 15m. Use LRU for tenant-state to bound memory. Also sample 1/100 requests to capture bits_seq + initial_kv_digest for replays.
samir: Telemetry proto needs fields: "bits_seq", "kv_header_present", "page_homogeneity", "tail_deg", "page_compacts", "evict_reason", "prompt_fingerprint". Keep them cheap and aggregated.
mina: Ops: can we run a shadow for header-only 20% traffic then a canary header+hysteresis 10%? ops-bot: scheduling.
ops-bot: Canary jobs created: shadow-header-20pct starting 6481240000, hyst-canary-10pct starting 6481240200. Results posted to #eng-ml-canaries.
oscar: Replay plan: capture compact tuple (model_sha, prompt_fingerprint, seed, initial_kv_digest, bits_seq, page_homogeneity_flag). Provide a helper that can reconstruct initial_kv_digest from sampled page snapshot. Recommend 0.5% shadow replays before enabling canary.
leah: Microbench plan: simulate 1k rps mixed-distribution and measure tokens/sec, p99 latency, mem pressure for (A) baseline packed, (B) header-only, (C) header+hysteresis pinned. Want numbers before canary.
samir: Also propose an opt-in tenant flag to pin to strict fidelity namespaces for customers that pay for higher quality SLAs. That helps offer a product knob and isolates perf regressions.
mina: Good business angle. Cost estimate required: project mem blowup for strict namespaces at 25/50/75% mixed traffic. @oscar can you produce a back-of-envelope?
oscar: Will run sim and post numbers in the PR.
telemetry-bot: Schema draft quant_fidelity.v1 created. Fields: bits_seq, kv_hdr, page_homog, tail_deg, compact_count, evict_cause, prompt_fp. Patch is ready for staging.
mina: Action items summary: (1) oscar -> microbench mem/throughput for header and strict namespaces, (2) leah -> implement scheduler hysteresis + LRU tenant-state, (3) samir -> KV header + safe-deserialization + replay helper, (4) ops -> run shadow + canary per plan and collect deg + perf. I'll open tracking issue and link PRs. Ping @leah when scheduler proto is up. :thumbsup:
